name: Faculty Glyphic
summary: Google Fonts specimen page for Faculty Glyphic, a single-weight sans-serif by Koto London inspired by carved typography.
description: Specimen page for Faculty Glyphic on Google Fonts, designed at Koto London in 2024 for Faculty, an applied-AI company. A sans-serif drawing on carved typography and the work of Berthold Wolpe and Edward Johnston, as a modern tribute to Wolpe's Albertus. One Regular (400) weight, no italics or variable axes; Latin and Latin Extended subsets; SIL Open Font License 1.1. The specimen page renders with JavaScript, so the facts come from the family's metadata.
